name: fit
title: Fit
description: How a stage occupies the screen, readable by any component inside it: the StageFit type, the set of fixed layouts, and useStageFit / useFixedSpace. Its own item so a component can choose defaults that suit a fixed screen (a leaderboard showing the top five) without installing Stage. Provided by Stage.
docs: Stage provides the fit. A host with its own shell can wrap a subtree in <StageFitProvider value="screen"> instead. useFixedSpace() is true in screen, canvas, card and sheet, and in launch only while it is open (Stage decides that).
